differential_expression_by_doid.name: differential_expression_by_doid
differential_expression_by_doid.body_sql:
SELECT
  gene_symbol,
  doid,
  pvalue,
  log2fc,
  adjpvalue,
  statistical_significance,
  expression_change_direction,
  subjects_total
FROM differential_expression
differential_expression_by_doid.description: Row-level cohort of differential expression results, one row per gene_symbol + doid combination. Exposes raw test statistics and subject counts to filter or aggregate later.

disease_by_name_lookup.name: disease_by_name_lookup
disease_by_name_lookup.body_sql:
SELECT
  d.id AS id,
  d.name AS name
FROM
  disease d
disease_by_name_lookup.description: Row-level disease lookup exposing disease id (DOID) and canonical name to support name-based filters (case-insensitive matches or partial matches).

differential_expression_with_disease_nam.name: differential_expression_with_disease_name
differential_expression_with_disease_nam.body_sql:
SELECT
  de.gene_symbol,
  de.doid,
  de.pvalue,
  d.name AS disease_name
FROM
  differential_expression_by_doid de
LEFT JOIN
  disease_by_name_lookup d
ON
  de.doid = d.id
differential_expression_with_disease_nam.description: Denormalized row-level view joining differential_expression to disease to expose gene-level differential expression alongside the disease name; one row per gene_symbol + doid.
